gbifID.description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility identifier uniquely assigned to each occurrence record.

datasetKey.description: Unique dataset identifier linking all records to a single GBIF dataset.

occurrenceID.description: Unique iNaturalist observation URL identifying each Roepera morgiana record.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for each observation, always Plantae.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for each observation, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the species, consistently Magnoliopsida.

order.description: Taxonomic order for all records is Zygophyllales.

family.description: Taxonomic family of the observed plant, consistently Zygophyllaceae.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus of the recorded plant, consistently Roepera across all observations.

species.description: Recorded plant taxon, consistently Roepera morgiana.

infraspecificEpithet.description: No infraspecific epithet data recorded for any observation.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank of the record, consistently recorded as species.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded Roepera morgiana species, identical across all observations.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name recorded verbatim as Roepera morgsana across all records.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Authorship of the scientific name is missing for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code identifying the nation of each observation, consistently “ZA” for South Africa.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

stateProvince.description: South African province where each Roepera morgiana observation was recorded.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status indicating that the species was observed at the recorded location.

individualCount.description: Number of individual organisms observed per record, recorded as an integer count.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude in decimal degrees for each observation location.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates measured in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision data missing for all records.

elevation.description: Elevation of observation site, measured in meters above sea level.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation measurement accuracy is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth data missing for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy values are missing for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Day of month when the observation was recorded.

month.description: Month of observation, ranging from January (1) to December (12).

year.description: Year when the observation was recorded.

taxonKey.description: Unique taxonomic identifier for each Roepera morgiana occurrence.

speciesKey.description: Species identifier code for Roepera morgiana.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, always human observation.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for observations, always iNaturalist.

collectionCode.description: All records share the same collection identifier indicating observation data.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: Placeholder field with no recorded values.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals or organizations who identified the Roepera morgiana occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Date and time when the specimen was identified.

license.description: Data usage license applied to each occurrence record, e.g., Creative Commons BY‑NC‑4.0.

rightsHolder.description: Individuals or organizations holding usage rights for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Roepera morgiana occurrence.

typeStatus.description: No type status information is recorded for any observation.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment status (e.g., native, introduced) for each occurrence, data unavailable.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when the record was last interpreted.

mediaType.description: Media format of observation, typically photographic still images.

issue.description: List of data quality flags applied to each record.

roepera_morgiana.description: Contains 1003 Roepera morgiana occurrence records (1995‑2026) with taxonomy, coordinates, dates, and observer metadata.

description: Records 1003 observations of Roepera morgiana occurrences from 1995 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
